title: Article 78 — Duties of Prime Minister as respects the furnishing of information to the President, etc.

content.overview: Article 78 imposes duties on the Prime Minister: (a) to communicate to the President all decisions of the Council of Ministers relating to the administration of the affairs of the Union and proposals for legislation; (b) to furnish such information relating to the administration of the affairs of the Union and proposals for legislation as the President may call for; and (c) if the President so requires, to submit for the consideration of the Council of Ministers any matter on which a decision has been taken by a Minister but which has not been considered by the Council.
content.glance: PM must: communicate CoM decisions to President; furnish information President calls for; submit Minister-only decisions to CoM if President requires.
content.study:
Article 78 duties of the Prime Minister:
(a) Communicate to the President all decisions of the Council of Ministers relating to Union administration and proposals for legislation.
(b) Furnish information on Union administration and legislative proposals as the President may call for.
(c) If the President requires, submit to the Council of Ministers any matter decided by a Minister but not considered by the Council.

This supports the President’s formal role and the collective character of the Council of Ministers.

Examination: three duties; communication; information on call; referral of Minister-level decisions to full Council.

sections.heading: Three duties
sections.body:
1. Communicate CoM decisions (administration + legislative proposals) to the President.
2. Furnish information the President calls for.
3. On President’s requirement: submit Minister-only decisions to the Council of Ministers for consideration.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What are the duties of the Prime Minister under Article 78?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 78, it is the duty of the Prime Minister to communicate to the President all decisions of the Council of Ministers relating to the administration of the affairs of the Union and proposals for legislation; to furnish such information relating to those matters as the President may call for; and, if the President so requires, to submit for the consideration of the Council of Ministers any matter on which a decision has been taken by a Minister but which has not been considered by the Council.

examTips: Communicate decisions; furnish information; refer Minister decisions to CoM if President requires.

keyTakeaways: Art 78: PM’s duties to inform and report to the President.
